experiment: tile BFS (ch07: 32x32 tiles closed in registers, rounds of tiles): its switches (one_sync, tile_paint, fused_pack, skip_full) timed as an ablation, each increment on top of the one before, against the old default (two grid.sync per round, separate pack, plain paint), vs ch03's conn4 / conn8 / warp-coop BFS kernels (instrumented and bare, several grids; ch03's best = the fastest of all its warp-coop grids) and ch06's run-table CCL (bare, and instrumented for its counters), one interleaved round-robin per scene, CUDA-event timings on every side, per-round samples saved

ch06_runs.run_capacity: max(8192, n/16, runs in the scene)

ch06_runs_bare.run_capacity: max(8192, n/16, runs in the scene)

timing_note: ch07 *_ms = pack + init + rounds + paint (first event to last; with fused_pack the pack interval is empty and the RGB is read inside rounds, with fused_paint so is paint). ch03 *_ms = its one kernel launch; its device reset is off the clock and timed separately (ch03_reset_ms). ch06_runs *_ms = pack + count + scan + emit + merge + flatten + paint, rgb contract (ch06_runs_bare: counters off). Every run: image restored from a device copy, 96 MB L2 flush read, GPU sleep kernel queued ahead so host launch overhead is excluded. <config>_e2e_ms = pageable H2D + pipeline + D2H of the painted image (perf_counter, reused buffers), for the old and the new default, instrumented. paired_<key>_* = median, min and max of the per-round ratio num/den (> 1: den is faster) and the rounds below 1. njit8_ms = the @njit oracle end to end (allocations, depth map, no paint), timed after all GPU scenes.
